## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and its user or developer impact.

## Security and privacy

Describe effects on untrusted-input handling, local processing, reproduction,
evidence contents, dependencies, or public claims. Confirm that the change
contains no credentials, customer material, protected evidence, weights, or
training data.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Formatting, licence, secret, dependency, and public-boundary checks pass.
- [ ] Schema and compatibility effects are documented.
- [ ] New output remains deterministic or the documented contract was updated.
- [ ] No security capability, model advantage, or production-readiness claim is
      made without corresponding qualification evidence.
